w: Swamishri celebrated Jal Zilani festival on a boat in the Indian Ocean. Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was customarily offered prayers and arti. 250 devotees celebrated the festival in the presence of Swamishri.
ph: Performing aarti during Jal Zilani festival Sep 21 1999

w: Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha of new murtis of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj and former murtis of Radha Krishna Dev, Hanumanji, Ganapatiji and Guru Parampara.

In the evening assembly, a procession of Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was carried out and He was honored by the devotees. The Deputy Mayor of Dallas, Mr. Steve Salazar, presented a bouquet and 'Key to the City' to Swamishri.

In the morning, Swamishri blessed the 10,000 devotees seated in the assembly held in honour of Shastriji Maharaj, “With Shastriji Maharaj were only five sadhus and a few devotees. Yet, he still built all these mandirs and spread Satsang. Anyone would have been deterred, thinking that it is not possible. But Shastriji Maharaj was determined. Even if someone has power and money, still he would struggle to build such mandirs. But God was with Shastriji Maharaj and so such work was accomplished. The spiritual knowledge of Akshar and Purushottam given by Shastriji Maharaj was not to earn honour, fame or glory. He tolerated many hardships to spread this knowledge and so today it has become widely accepted. Swami was slim, but he had the strength of God so the work was accomplished.”
A youth said, "As long as I am in the mandir I have very good thoughts, but as soon as I go out, all sorts of other thoughts cling to me. My eyes turn towards women. Please bless me."
Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "For that, pray, and when you see anything like that, close your eyes and think of the glory of Shriji Maharaj."

Every morning, without drinking a single drop of water, Pramukh Swami Maharaj meets on average more than 150 devotees and listens to their troubles. Mostly the time is never enough. In today's meetings, more visitors came with such problems. One devotee after another kept coming and going. There seemed to be no end anywhere. The joy that surges in these devotees' hearts after meeting Swamishri and receiving his blessings is something else altogether.

Today's meetings were over. Swamishri was going towards his room and said, "Iti Vachanamrutam (Thus ends the Vachanamrut)." It was as if Swamishri was saying that only when one comes to the refuge of God and the Sant and keeps faith and trust do problems come to an end, and only then does "Iti Vachanamrutam" become possible.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Pray for that, and when you see anything like that, close your eyes and think of the glory of Shriji Maharaj."

Today's meetings came to an end. As Swamishri was going towards his room, he said, "Iti Vachanamrutam (thus ends the discourse)." It was as if Swamishri was saying that only when one comes to the refuge of Bhagwan and the Sant and keeps faith and trust do problems come to an end, and only then is "Iti Vachanamrutam" possible.
Today after breakfast, giving guidance on management to the sadhus running the "Sanskrit Mahavidyalaya" in Sarangpur,
Mahant Swami Maharaj said:

"Prepare the students so that none remains weak. None gets disheartened. Just as we sow a mango seed and it grows, prepare them so that they come forward in both worldly dealings and upasana. They should not speak half heartedly. There should not be the least negativity.

"Give training so that the students become practical. Prepare them so that they can settle anywhere. In America there was a very intelligent person. He was skilled in his work too. So his superiors thought that if they put fifty other employees with him, all would be trained. But doing so had the opposite result. That intelligent person could not work while staying with everyone. So prepare them to be able to work together with everyone. Make them people of character. They may make mistakes, but they should not get stuck. Falling is not a crime, but staying fallen is a crime. In preparing everyone this way, you will have to keep a great deal of forgiveness..."
Thus Swamishri drew the map for running the Sanskrit Mahavidyalaya. Indeed, in it lies the key to the successful running of any educational unit.

Today after the midday meal, a sadhak, on the basis of the couplet "Nane se ho nane rahie..." (remain small, as the small one), asked Mahant Swami Maharaj for blessings to remain as the servant of servants. Just as he finished, a sadhu recited Swamibapa's incident, "We will grant liberation in a snap", and asked Swamishri himself, "You too will grant liberation in a snap, won't you?"
"If one remains the servant of servants, liberation in a snap." Swamishri showed the precise and short path to liberation.

ds.t: The ones who make it up
w: Today, when Mahant Swami Maharaj sat for breakfast, Ishwarcharandas Swami said, addressing the sadhus:

"By Swamishri's grace, because of all this, things get done and financial seva (donations) comes in, but Shastriji Maharaj gave the blessing that 'whenever there is a need, there will be no problem, but...'"
Swamishri laughed and said, "There will always be a shortage."
Ishwarcharandas Swami said, "And if there is difficulty, Mahant Swami Maharaj is sitting here to make up for it."
Swamishri immediately pointed behind him to the murtis of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Yogi Bapa and Swami Bapa and said, "These are the ones who make it up, not me..."
Only when Swamishri never misses, even for a moment, the awareness that Maharaj and Swami are the doers can he respond so instantly in this way.
On the plane from Robbinsville to London.

Mahant Swami Maharaj got up to pass urine. Yogichintandas Swami took Swamishri as far as the bathroom. After passing urine, Swamishri came out; he had also had to spit out phlegm in the washbasin. He tried to clean it himself, but it had stuck in the drain, so he pointed it out to Yogichintandas Swami and said, "Clean it properly..." When he returned to his seat, he also drew his attendant Shrutipriyadas Swami's attention to it.
This aircraft must have carried thousands of passengers, but it would rarely have had a passenger like this.
